patient_name.why: so your care team knows who they're looking after

age.why: so we can shape the journey correctly from the very start — and bring in a parent or guardian if you are under 18

guardian_name.q: Because you're under 18, a parent or guardian will be part of every step of this journey. What's their full name?
guardian_name.why: we never plan care for anyone under 18 without a guardian involved — they approve every decision alongside you

guardian_contact.q: And the best phone number or email to reach them?
guardian_contact.why: so your care team can include your guardian directly in every confirmation and consent step

procedure_interest.q: What would you like to improve or treat? You can choose more than one.
procedure_interest.why: so we can begin matching you with the right specialists — and check that everything you choose can be safely combined

destination_country.q: Do you have a destination in mind, or would you like a recommendation?
destination_country.why: so we can find doctors licensed in your destination

email.q: Where should I send what I'm finding for you?
email.why: so the doctors, prices, and plan I'm putting together reach your inbox — and you never lose your place

phone.q: A phone number, in case we need to reach you quickly?
phone.why: so your coordinator can reach you directly if anything needs your attention

doctor_selection.q: Based on your procedure and destination, here are your matched doctors.
doctor_selection.why: so you can choose who cares for you, or let your care team recommend the best match

gender.why: a detail your doctor uses to plan your procedure correctly

nationality.why: so we can check visa and travel requirements ahead of time

medical_conditions_other.q: Do you have any medical conditions your doctor should know about?
medical_conditions_other.why: so your doctor can prepare the safest possible plan for you

allergy_details.q: Any allergies — medications, foods, or otherwise?
allergy_details.why: so nothing is prescribed or served that could harm you

medications.q: Are you taking any medications or supplements right now?
medications.why: some medications and supplements change how surgery, anesthesia, and healing go — your doctor needs the full picture

anesthesia_history.q: Have you ever had a bad reaction to anesthesia?
anesthesia_history.why: a previous reaction tells your anesthesiologist exactly how to keep you safe this time

surgery_history.why: past operations affect healing and planning — even ones that went perfectly

has_companion.q: Will someone be travelling with you?
has_companion.why: so we can plan for one traveller or more from the start

preferred_date.q: When would you like to travel?
preferred_date.why: so we can check your doctor's and destination's availability

duration_of_stay.q: How long can you stay for recovery?
duration_of_stay.why: so your recovery plan and accommodation match your schedule

clinical_boundary_acknowledged.q: One last thing — please confirm you understand Morales coordinates your care but doesn't diagnose or prescribe. Your doctor makes every clinical decision.
clinical_boundary_acknowledged.why: a clear boundary we hold with every patient, always

final_review.q: Here's everything I've gathered — take a look before I send it to your care team.
final_review.why: so nothing goes to your care team without your review

home.feature_family_desc: Share a zero-login link and they watch every checkpoint in real time — like a flight tracker, but for your surgery.
home.feature_checkpoint_desc: Miss a check-in and we escalate automatically — SMS, voice call, security dispatch, police. You are never alone.
home.feature_verified_desc: Every doctor is screened for credentials, procedure history, and patient outcomes. Only the top 1% earn the Morales badge.
home.after_surgery_a:
That's where Morales
becomes most valuable.
home.after_surgery_p:
Most platforms track your booking.
Morales tracks you — until you are home safe.
home.step1_title: Recovery monitoring starts the moment surgery ends.
home.step1_desc: Your recovery clock starts immediately. Miss a check-in by 45 minutes and Morales escalates automatically — not 24 hours later. 45 minutes.
home.step2_title: Your family never loses sight of you.
home.step2_desc: A zero-login link. A live map. Every checkpoint confirmed in real time. They sleep peacefully. We don't.
home.step3_title: Six channels before we give up.
home.step3_desc: SMS. Voice call. Companion check. Security dispatch. Local clinic. Emergency services. In sequence — until someone confirms you are safe.

about.headline: Your Safety, Our Mission
about.intro: Morales Medical Travel Safety was founded on a simple principle: everyone deserves access to world-class medical care abroad, delivered with uncompromising safety and personalized attention.
about.quote_caption: Our guiding philosophy since day one
about.value_safety_desc: Every decision we make puts your safety and wellbeing above all else.
about.value_patient_desc: Your goals, your timeline, your comfort — everything is built around you.
about.value_access_desc: We connect you with the finest specialists and facilities globally.
about.value_excellence_desc: A track record of 500+ successful transformations and 98% satisfaction.

how_it_works.subtitle: No forms to learn, no steps to memorize. You just talk — M-Care handles the rest, from the first sentence to the day you're home safe.
how_it_works.step1_desc: Type it or say it — "I want dental implants in Mexico" is enough to start. No form, no dropdown menus. M-Care asks what it actually needs to know, one real question at a time.
how_it_works.step2_title: Your Safety Screening Happens As You Talk
how_it_works.step2_desc: M-Care runs your safety screening right there in the conversation. If anything needs a closer look, it says so plainly and loops in a doctor — safety decisions are never left to guesswork.
how_it_works.step3_title: M-Care Matches You With a Verified Doctor
how_it_works.step3_desc: Every doctor M-Care can recommend has already cleared Morales's full verification — license, identity, and background. You're never introduced to someone unvetted.
how_it_works.step4_desc: Travel, hotel, transport — M-Care requests real quotes from real, verified partners and keeps you updated as they come in, instead of leaving you to book each piece yourself.
how_it_works.step5_title: Your Procedure, With Someone Morales Has Verified
how_it_works.step5_desc: You arrive knowing your doctor has already been checked, your safety screening is on file, and your care team knows exactly who you are.
how_it_works.step6_desc: Real check-ins during recovery, not a form to fill out later. If something feels off, just tell M-Care — it's still listening.
how_it_works.step7_desc: Questions after you're home go to the same place everything else did — a conversation with M-Care, anytime.
how_it_works.cta_sub: No forms. No learning curve. Tell M-Care what you need.
